title: Paraeus: sure fiducia — remission, justice, and life granted to me in particular
source_text: LVII. His accedit Paraeus, dum fidem dicit esse certam fiduciam, qua in Deo acquiescimus certo statuentes, non solum aliis in generali, sed & mihi, tibi, in particulari, remissionem peccatorum, aeternam justitiam, & vitam donari, ex Dei misericordia, propter unius Christi meritum. In lib. 1. Bell. de Justif. c. 4. in Appendice.
pass_a_gloss: To these agrees Paraeus, when he says faith is a sure trust by which we rest in God, certainly laying down that not only to others in general, but also to me, to you, in particular, remission of sins, eternal justice, and life are given, from God's mercy, for the merit of Christ alone. In book 1 of Bellarmine on Justification, chapter 4, in the Appendix.
pass_b_english: Paraeus: faith = sure fiducia resting in God.
Sure that remission, eternal justice, and life are given not only to others in general but to me/you in particular.
From God’s mercy for Christ’s merit alone.
